lines.en: In muddy water, my whiskers find the way.

lines.zh: 我贴着水底游，肚皮蹭泥。
lines.en: I swim near the bottom, belly grazing mud.

lines.zh: 沼泽的根须缠住了我的鳍。
lines.en: Swamp roots have tangled around my fins.
The water shallows ahead; I glide over.
I flick my tail and stir up the silt.
I take this channel every single day.
It is cooler beneath the duckweed.
I swim slowly to save my strength.

lines.zh: 有根木头横在水里，我绕开。
lines.en: A log lies across the water; I go around.

lines.zh: 我的须子先碰到冰凉的石头。
lines.en: My whiskers touch a cold stone first.
A string of bubbles rises from the mud.
I follow along the edge of the weeds.

lines.zh: 这片沼泽连着很多条沟。
lines.en: This swamp is joined by many narrow ditches.
Deeper water only sharpens my whiskers.

lines.zh: 我钻进泥洞，只留须在外。
lines.en: I slip into a mud hole, whiskers out.

lines.zh: 前面有块沉木，我从下面过。
lines.en: A sunken log ahead; I pass beneath.
I lie on the mud, fins still fanning.
Fog presses on the water, thick and muggy.
A frog is calling somewhere far off.
The barbels by my mouth sway gently.
The sunken leaves on the bottom are soft.
I open my mouth and let water drift through.
The mud tastes stronger than before.

lines.zh: 我在等天黑，那时才活跃。
lines.en: I wait for nightfall, my liveliest hour.

lines.zh: 头顶的睡莲叶挡住太阳。
lines.en: Lily pads overhead block out the sun.

lines.zh: 一条小鱼从我须边溜了。
lines.en: A small fish slipped past my whiskers.
The water is quiet, good for dozing.
My spots look just like rotting mud.
This hollow is deep enough to hide me.
My gills open and close, slow and steady.

lines.zh: 你站在岸上，影子落到水里。
lines.en: You stand ashore; your shadow reaches the water.
Your boots are sinking into the mire.

lines.zh: 我浮上来，看你手里的桶。
lines.en: I surface to look at the bucket you hold.
My whiskers touch your reflection.
Are you netting me or feeding me?
The reeds are moving; is that you?
I cannot see you, but I smell you.
You muddy the water and I panic.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛小，只能看个轮廓。
lines.en: My eyes are small; I see only shapes.
Stay crouched and you sink deeper.
The blow drove me down into the mud.
A scale came loose and drifted away.
One of my whiskers has snapped.
The water clouded and I lost sight.
I rolled over on the muddy bottom.

lines.zh: 这力气比沼泽里的东西大多了。
lines.en: That hit was stronger than anything in the swamp.
I burrow toward the reed roots.
The pain makes my tail thrash wildly.
Mud covers the smell of blood, good.

lines.zh: 再打我就钻泥里不出来。
lines.en: Hit me again and I stay buried in mud.

lines.zh: 有蚯蚓味，从你手上来的。
lines.en: There is an earthworm smell from your hands.

lines.zh: 那块生鱼，扔到水里就好。
lines.en: Toss that raw fish into the water, please.

lines.zh: 我闻到血味了，是鱼的血。
lines.en: I smell blood, and it is fish blood.

lines.zh: 你别站在泥里，过来一点。
lines.en: Don't stand in the mud; come closer.
I have opened my mouth wide; see?
Lower it slowly; don't splash.

lines.zh: 这味道让我鳍都竖起来。
lines.en: That smell makes my fins stand up.
I have circled it three times already.
A moment more, and I will bite.

lines.zh: 沼泽里很少有这么香的东西。
lines.en: The swamp rarely offers anything this rich.

lines.zh: 你涉水时踢到了我的背。
lines.en: You waded in and kicked my back.
I got knocked into a clump of weeds.

lines.zh: 你的腿在水里像一根柱子。
lines.en: Your leg stands in the water like a post.
That bump filled my mouth with mud.

lines.zh: 船底擦过我的背，掉了鳞。
lines.en: A boat hull scraped my back and shed scales.

lines.zh: 我贴着你的靴子滑过去。
lines.en: I slid right past the side of your boot.
Don't stomp in the water; it rattles me.
The surface churned; I nearly beached myself.
I was shoved against the reed roots.
Step back a little; I am about to turn.
The warm swamp water suits us now.
Your whiskers are a little longer than mine.

lines.zh: 我们在泥坑里并排待着。
lines.en: We rest side by side in the mud hole.
When the water rises, we swim together.
Easy; let the water settle first.
No other fish share this shallow flat.

lines.zh: 我绕着你转，尾鳍碰着你。
lines.en: I circle you, tail fin brushing yours.

lines.zh: 泥里那窝，我守了好几天。
lines.en: I have guarded that nest in the mud for days.

lines.zh: 你的颜色在浑水里正好。
lines.en: Your colors blend well in this murk.

lines.zh: 等小鱼出来，沼泽就热闹了。
lines.en: Once the fry hatch, the swamp will be lively.

lines.zh: 你用水桶舀我，桶壁好滑。
lines.en: You scooped me up; the bucket wall is slick.
Little water in here; I cannot turn.

lines.zh: 晃得太厉害，我须子都缠住了。
lines.en: Too much sloshing; my whiskers are tangled.

lines.zh: 放点水草进去，我会踏实。
lines.en: Add some weeds and I will settle down.
Don't carry me around under the sun.
The bucket floor is hard, unlike mud.

lines.zh: 我能听见外面沼泽的声音。
lines.en: I can still hear the swamp outside.
Pour me out gently; don't drop me.

lines.zh: 我在桶里绕圈，停不下来。
lines.en: I circle this bucket and cannot stop.

lines.zh: 这一桶水，够我活一阵子。
lines.en: This much water keeps me alive a while.
Something at the bottom is turning mud.

lines.zh: 我锁定了那条慢吞吞的小鱼。
lines.en: I have picked out that slow little fish.
Its tail is showing through the weeds.
First I circle around upstream of it.
A fishy smell comes from this direction.
I lower myself and hug the muddy floor.
It has not noticed my whiskers yet.

lines.zh: 就等它离开水草那一瞬。
lines.en: I wait for it to leave the weed cover.
Slowly, I open my mouth.
This meal will hold me until tomorrow.

lines.zh: 我盯着它，须子一动不动。
lines.en: I stare, whiskers perfectly still.
The moment it turns, I follow.
Don't dangle by my mouth or you'll be bitten.

lines.zh: 我的须已经感到水动了。
lines.en: My whiskers already feel the water shift.
Half an inch closer is all I need.

lines.zh: 我把身子弓起来准备冲。
lines.en: I arch my body, ready to lunge.
It is upstream; I must swing around.
The muddy water keeps me hidden.
I have waited a long while for this.
Tail fin hovering, I wait for it to move.
I bit once, and only once.
My teeth are fine; the wound is small.

lines.zh: 水花溅起来，把目标吓跑了。
lines.en: The splash scared my target clean away.
I can only bite into soft things.
It tastes of mud, not very good.
I shake my head and press it into mud.
A hand in the water reads as prey to me.
Not much force, but the aim was true.
My whiskers find the spot first.
After the bite, I back into the mud.

lines.zh: 我在沼泽的浅水里醒来。
lines.en: I wake in the shallows of the swamp.
Thick silt sits right beneath me.
Fog is drifting low across the water.
Frogs and mosquitoes share this place.
First I find some weeds to hide in.
The water is shallow, perfect for hiding.

lines.zh: 我的须一出来就碰到东西。
lines.en: My whiskers brushed something immediately.

lines.zh: 这片沼泽有很多浑水沟。
lines.en: This swamp has many muddy little channels.
A quick lap first, to learn the routes.
There should be fish like me around here.

lines.zh: 水一下烫了，我往深处沉。
lines.en: The water turned hot; I sink deeper.

lines.zh: 我被甩到岸上，扑腾了半天。
lines.en: Flung onto land, I flopped for a long while.

lines.zh: 这里没有水，我的鳃在干烧。
lines.en: No water here; my gills are burning dry.

lines.zh: 水被炸开，我被掀到半空。
lines.en: The blast threw the water and me upward.

lines.zh: 箭射进水里，从我背边过。
lines.en: An arrow cut the water past my back.

lines.zh: 那道光让我的须都僵了。
lines.en: That light stiffened all my whiskers.
I have not caught a fish in days.

lines.zh: 雷落进沼泽，水里全是麻。
lines.en: Lightning struck the swamp; the water stings.
There is neither mud nor water here.
